title: Wine Jam Silk Anarkali Suit Set with Hand-Worked Yoke & Organza Cutwork Dupatta
color_custom: Deep wine with pink & silver hand embroidery
description:
Jamuni is the deep purple-wine of the ripe jamun fruit – rich, warm and quietly regal.

A deep wine Anarkali in soft jam silk, with a gentle sheen that glows in evening light. The yoke is hand-worked – a delicate scalloped line of white beads and tiny pink sequins traces the V-neckline. Below the yoke, soft gathers open into a full, flowing flare. It comes with matching jam silk pants and a shimmering organza dupatta, hand-embroidered with pink and silver flowers along a scalloped cutwork border.

✦ The Details
• Hand work on the yoke – white beads and pink sequins along the V-neckline
• Soft gathers below the yoke into a full Anarkali flare
• Full sleeves
• Matching jam silk pants
• Organza dupatta with hand-embroidered flowers and a scalloped cutwork edge
• 3-piece set: Anarkali, pants and dupatta

✦ Fabric & Craft
Jam silk is a smooth, soft fabric with a subtle sheen and a fluid fall – richer than cotton, lighter than heavy silk. The yoke is worked by hand, and the dupatta's flowers are hand-embroidered before the edge is cut into scallops, so small variations are part of its handmade charm.

✦ Fit & Size
Relaxed, flowy fit through the skirt. Choose your usual size or use our Fit Finder. Between sizes? Size up – or send us your bust, waist and hip and we will stitch it to your measurements.

✦ How to Style It
Silver jhumkas, soft open hair and clear heels for a sangeet or festive dinner; drape the dupatta on one shoulder so the cutwork border falls in front. For Diwali or a reception, add a small bindi, a potli bag and antique silver jewellery. Abroad, a cream or camel long coat looks lovely over deep wine.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Dry clean only. Store the dupatta folded loosely in a muslin cloth so the cutwork edge does not snag. Iron the Anarkali on low heat on the reverse side; steam the organza.
